patterns.note: Full-bleed imagery and video are used as dominant section backgrounds, often with text overlaid directly on them or within a contrasting content block.
A sophisticated pairing of an elegant, large-scale serif font for display headings and a clean, functional sans-serif for body text and navigation creates a distinct editorial feel.
The site employs a muted, earthy color palette dominated by browns, dark greens, and off-whites, lending a natural and somewhat somber aesthetic.
A persistent header with the site logo and navigation links remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing constant access to key sections.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, often accompanied by a full-width background color or texture change.
Sections are clearly delineated by full-width background changes, alternating between solid colors, textured patterns, and full-bleed imagery or video.

technique_notes: To rebuild the sticky header, position the header element fixed to the top of the viewport, ensuring it has a high z-index to overlay scrolling content.
The video hero is implemented as a full-width, auto-playing, muted background video that scales to cover its container, with text content positioned on top.
Section reveals can be achieved by applying a CSS transition to opacity and transform properties (e.g., `translateY`) when elements intersect the viewport, triggered by an Intersection Observer API.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) provide a strong visual anchor, contrasted with smaller, functional sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating a sophisticated hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical spacing between sections and within hero areas allows imagery and text to breathe, creating a calm and expansive feel.

standout: This site stands out with its art-forward approach, using classical or painterly full-bleed imagery and video combined with a sophisticated, almost editorial serif typography. The muted, earthy color palette and subtle motion create a distinctive, high-end artistic mood that feels more like a gallery or art book than a typical band website.
